executable.name: Reactive GRASP - Prais-Ribeiro
executable.construction: canonical threshold RCL with discrete adaptive alpha selection
executable.selection: Prais-Ribeiro probability update over alpha values

executable.name: GRASP with Path Relinking
executable.construction: canonical threshold RCL followed by reusable local search
executable.selection: uniform elite-guide reservoir selection + configurable greedy or greedy-randomized target-directed move selection
executable.memory: fixed-capacity quality/diversity elite pool with Resende-Werneck evolutionary admission
executable.path: forward / backward / back-and-forward / mixed; optional truncation; optional generational all-pairs EvPR
